summary: Renders a position or gear indicator text at screen coordinates. For a1 == -1 resolves and copies the localized error string (byte_5CCEC4) into byte_5EC4CC and then into the display buffer; for a1 == 0 does the same with the localized neutral string aN; otherwise formats the numeric value a1 with "%d" into the display buffer. When sub_49B7A0(&unk_7CE234) & 0xF equals 0xF the text color becomes red (16711680) instead of the default yellow (16776960), and UITextRenderWithScale draws the buffer with scale and alignment parameters.

operations.description: Default render color v3 set to yellow 16776960.
Branch on a1 == -1 for the error/invalid position display.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, byte_5CCEC4, byte_5EC4CC) resolves the localized error string.
Copy the byte_5CCEC4 error string into byte_5EC4CC one byte at a time until the NUL terminator.
sub_587DD0(v9, byte_5EC4CC, 9) safe-copies the resolved string into the 9-byte display buffer v9.
Branch on a1 == 0 for the neutral position display.
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aN, byte_5EC4CC) resolves the localized neutral "N" string.
Copy the aN string into byte_5EC4CC one byte at a time until the NUL terminator.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v9, "%d", a1) formats the positive numeric value into the display buffer.
Check the flag from sub_49B7A0(&unk_7CE234): when masked with 0xF it equals 0xF, select the failure color.
Set render color v3 to red 16711680 when the appearance flag matches.
UITextRenderWithScale(v9, a2, a3, v3, 2, 0, 1.25, 1.5) renders the text buffer at the given coordinates with color, alignment and scale.
